name: Exterior Aluminum Siding RP Surface Preparation
intent: Pressure wash with TSP, chalk verification gate, oxide layer scuff, DFT verification, caulk assessment (QT3).
doctrine: Aluminum siding prep. Chalk severity drives prep intensity: none=1.0x, light=1.25x (TSP + verify), heavy=1.75x (multiple passes + mechanical scrub). Chalk verification is mandatory gate — must pass hand-rub test before priming. No warranty void gate (unlike vinyl). No LRV restriction.
